main.description: What a running check's steps printed, as its runner sent it (dev.knotless.putRunOutput): the text after a cursor, the steps that ended and the one going, for a client that follows no server-sent events. The appview keeps the last megabyte of a run in memory while it runs, and a while after; the check's record keeps its log. With nothing new and the run going, it waits up to `wait` seconds for more. Answers as dev.knotless.getCheck does for the same viewer: anyone may read a public repository's, its members a private one's.

errors.description: No such repository, no such check of it by a runner it names, or as many runs followed as the appview keeps.
errors.name: NotFound

cursor.description: Where `text` ends, in this run: given back, it asks for what comes after.

ended.description: Whether the run's steps are over: its record is filed with its result in a moment.

going.description: The name of the step running now: none between steps.

steps.description: The steps that ended so far, as the check's record will say.

text.description: What the steps printed after `cursor`, each step's after a line `==> <name>`, in whole lines masked as the log is: nothing before the runner first sends.

cursor.description: Where an earlier answer ended: only what was printed after it is given. With none, or one of another run of the check, as a rerun at the same commit is, all that is kept.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getCheck takes it.

uri.description: The dev.knotless.check record, by a runner the repository names.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for more when nothing was printed after `cursor` and the run has not ended.

description: What a check's run has printed so far, as its runner sends it to the appview.
